Warm-up

Say it the exam way

Electrons in motion around atomic nuclei each produce a effect. In iron, nickel and cobalt, magnetic can be made to align. The material becomes . This is called .

Inside a long solenoid the field lines are straight, parallel and evenly . An iron core makes the lines more densely . Earth's geographic North Pole is a magnetic pole.

The strong nuclear force is the strongest of the four forces, but it has the range. Gravity is the .

Errors that cost marks

  • Solenoid: straight, parallel lines inside, and arrows.
  • Ferromagnetic: dipoles can be made to align.
